highlights: The Green Lion GM-92X Wireless Microphone, available in black, has been made for creators who require crystal clear audio and do not want to be bothered by technical issues.

The microphone, which is designed as an omnidirectional microphone with a 360° range, picks up voices in a very natural way from all sides and thus perfectly fits the use in interviews, vlogs, presentations, and live recordings.
Its instant recording feature, thanks to the plug-and-play setup, allows you to start recording without the need for apps or pairing and the like.
Wireless transmission at 2.4GHz guarantees a steady connection with an extended range of up to 40 meters, and ultra-low latency keeps the audio perfectly synchronized.

Noise cancellation and a 20dB noise reduction rate contribute to the cleaning up of sound by eliminating background noise. The dual mic recording functionality allows for the simultaneous use of two microphones, and the reverb mode applies in cases where more richness is required.
The compact design of the clip-on type microphone makes it both comfortable and invisible, while its LED indicators show the status of the microphone at a glance.
The GM-92X offers a hefty 20 hours of total use, including the charging case, so it is always ready when the creative juices flow.
